title: Transcript Tidy
user: People who absorb text better than video or audio, including ADHD users, who need an existing TED or YouTube transcript rendered as a stable, readable document.
smallest_useful_product: Browser extension that detects an on-page transcript/caption track the user can already access, reflows it into paragraphs with headings and find-in-video links, and exports the user-visible text locally.
success_measure: At least 60% of beta users finish reading three imported transcripts and use search or a timestamp jump in the first week.
constraints: Respect site terms and user-visible caption availability; do not redistribute copyrighted transcripts; keep processing local and disclose unsupported sites.
